ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a box plot of two variables A1 and B1, and the vertical axis scale goes from 0 to 40. Then reason: the data range equals the maximum value minus the minimum value. The range of A1 is approximately 36 - 2 = 34; the range of B1 is approximately 13 - 7 = 6. method.method_draft: Read the box plot’s vertical whisker endpoints against the y-axis grid. A1 has a minimum around 2 and a maximum around 36, while B1 has a minimum around 7 and a maximum around 13. Compute each range as maximum minus minimum: A1 is about 36−2=34, B1 is about 13−7=6. Since 34 is larger than 6, A1 has the larger range.
